title: Paul McCartney live: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino, Las Vegas | 2009
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 19 April 2009.

The show took place at The Joint, to help celebrate the opening of the Hard Rock Hotel’s newest venture. All 4,000 tickets for the show sold out in just seven seconds on 14 February.

Ringo Starr had performed at The Joint on 13 March 1999.
